item.title: Version 4.7.0
item.description:
Notch So Good 4.7.0

  • Answer from the notch: approvals now come from Claude Code's and Codex's own permission hooks, so a card appears exactly when the agent would ask; questions and plans can be answered there too
  • See what you approve: the full command, file edits as a diff, and Always allow saves Claude's own suggested rule for this project
  • Updates itself from now on: new versions download quietly and wait for a restart
  • Finished cards show files edited and test results; jump to the exact tab and tmux pane
  • Usage that's out of date says so, and "usage is back" when a window resets
  • Quieter: only blockers over full-screen apps, sound for blockers only, optional hiding from screen sharing
  • Gemini CLI (beta), Conductor questions shown in the notch, and a health check in Settings
  • Peek has a new icon, tricks between tasks, and dozes when things go quiet

Install this one by hand: run brew upgrade notch-so-good, or download it from the release page. From 4.7.0 on, updates install themselves.
